metadata.title: Two Neglected Dams and a City Swept to the Sea
metadata.description:
Derna collapsed and flooded the city of Derna. The cause: cascading failure of two embankment dams not maintained for decades.

Failure chain: Cracks reported → No maintenance → Storm Daniel → Upper dam fails → Lower dam fails

Related episode: The Man Accused of Breaking a Levee to Strand His Wife — https://youtu.be/WDMBEza0Sd4

Series — Infrastructure Failures: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLEtVY8dbosy0

Technical references:
• Wikipedia — 2023 Derna dam collapse — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Derna_dam_collapse
• Academic / engineering journal — 10.51984/jopas.v21i2 (cited by Wikipedia) — https://doi.org/10.51984%2Fjopas.v21i2

Narration uses a synthetic voice. Original animation: no archival or stock footage; reconstructions and illustrations are labelled on screen.
